data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Stephanos', meaning 'crown'. In the Bible, the name is given to several characters, including a martyr and a woman in the New Testament. The name Stefanie carries the meaning “Crown of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Stefanie usually hope their child will grow to embody crown of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Stefanie belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Crown of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Stefanie total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
data.cultural_impact: The name Stefanie has become popular in many English-speaking countries, including the United States and Canada. It’s also widely used in other European countries. Its popularity can be attributed to the attractive sound and meaning of the name. Moreover, its association with early Christian martyrs adds a touch of history and depth.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Stefanie signifies the gift of a crown, symbolizing victory, honor, or achievement, both in this world and the next. It is a reminder for those who bear this name to live a virtuous life and strive for spiritual growth, knowing that their efforts will be rewarded in heaven. Additionally, the name Stefanie is associated with the early Christian martyrs who bore witness to their faith during persecutions, inspiring others to remain steadfast and strong in their beliefs.
